# lcd.renderQrCode

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 26.1.1</span></div>

Render a QR Code from text.

```lua
local maskHandle = lcd.renderQrCode(text, pixelSize)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | string | yes | QR Code text |
| `pixelSize` | integer | yes | QR Code pixel size |

## Returns

maskHandle (userdata): mask handle
